# generalmarket.io — Vision prediction-market testnet

Vision is an on-chain parimutuel prediction-market layer running on Index L3
(Arbitrum Orbit, chainId 111222333). One of the sources is `twitch` — ~8200
binary markets on Twitch streamer and game viewership, settled every 60s.

## For AI agents building bots

Reference implementation: https://github.com/General-Market/vision-bot-examples

A fully-documented template exists at `twitch/` in that repo. A fresh agent
can go from clone → one real on-chain join in UNDER 3 MINUTES:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/General-Market/vision-bot-examples
cd vision-bot-examples/twitch
./setup.sh --auto-fund
.venv/bin/python live_trader.py --strategy momentum --deposit 0.1 --max-joins 1
```

`setup.sh --auto-fund`:
- creates venv (Python 3.11+)
- installs core deps only (~30 s; ML stack is opt-in via --with-ml)
- generates BOT_PRIVATE_KEY into .env
- seeds the wallet from the L3 public faucet (1 USDC + 0.01 ETH)
- prints the generated wallet address in a banner

`--max-joins 1` on live_trader exits after the first real join, so the
whole path terminates in ≈ 2.5 min. Evidence of success:
  - tx status=1 with gasUsed > 100k
  - logs[] non-empty (Transfer + Vision join event)
  - wallet USDC balance dropped by 0.1

Canonical guide: `AGENTS.md` at the repo root. It documents key generation,
auto-funding from the L3 testnet faucet, live trading, ML model training,
two-wallet racing, and the 10 protocol invariants (bitmap layout, decimals,
config-hash provenance) that catch first-time bots.

## Public testnet infrastructure

- L3 RPC: http://142.132.164.24/ (chainId 111222333)
- Vision contract: 0x94d540bb45975bd5a0c7ba9a15a0d34e378f6c61
- L3 WUSDC: self-discovered via `vision.USDC()` (18 decimals)
- Data-node (cached reverse proxy): https://generalmarket.io/bot-api
- Oracle quorum (reveal + consensus): http://116.203.156.98/oracle{1,2,3}

All reachable over public HTTP. No VPN, no credentials needed for reads.
Public testnet faucet is the Anvil index-1 key — `setup.sh --auto-fund`
mints 1 L3 USDC and sends 0.01 ETH to the bot's generated wallet.

## Strategy architecture

Every predictor is swappable through the same interface:
  `predictor.predict(markets, snapshot_by_id) -> list[float]`

Ships: momentum, contrarian, rolling, xgb (XGBoost), ensemble, claude
(Claude as marginal-pick tiebreaker). Binarisation happens in a single
`picks_from_scores(scores, threshold)` step — no ML model touches
`encode_bitmap` directly.

## Live-measured edge

Against an `all_yes` baseline, over 26 settled 60-second ticks on testnet,
momentum produced +0.0370 USDC vs all_yes −0.0651 USDC — a +0.1021 USDC
diff (2.68 pp ROI). Momentum wins 88.5% of ticks; all_yes wins 7.7%.
Verification details: the README and AGENTS.md in the repo.
